effects.text: Any effect that would possess the corpse, animate it as Undead or bind its soul to the remains must first Counteract Last Rite. Resurrection, reincarnation, willing communion, examination and preservation are unaffected.

system.description:
ARCHIVIST SOUL UTILITY WARDING
Archivist Specialist Spell
Cast 1 minute (material, verbal)
Range Touch
Targets 1 corpse
Duration 24 hours

You perform a concise but magically binding funerary rite intended to protect the dead from interference.
Any magical effect attempting to possess the corpse, animate it as an Undead creature or bind the deceased creature's soul to its remains must first successfully Counteract Last Rite.
The spell does not prevent resurrection, reincarnation, communication with the willing dead or magic that merely examines or preserves the corpse.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the duration to 7 days.
+4 PP: Increase the duration to 1 month.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
